title: Vaporesso DOJO Blast Pod & Refill For 10K or 30K Device – Passion Fruitini
description: Please Note: Compatible with Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K & 30K Kit Only Refresh your Vaporesso Dojo Blast 10K vape kit with the Passion Fruitini Prefilled Pod & Refill Pack. This convenient replacement pack includes a 2ml prefilled pod and an 8ml refill container, both filled with 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid in a vibrant, exotic fruit blend. Passion Fruitini captures the intense, tropical sweetness and sharp tang of ripe Passionfruit. This concentrated and exotic flavour profile provides a deeply satisfying and fruity vape with a beautifully smooth finish. Each pod and refill pack is designed for the Dojo Blast 10K device, while also being fully compatible with the Vaporesso Dojo Blast 30K prefilled pod kit. Offering up to 10,000 puffs* per pack, it is powered by Vaporesso's dual mesh coil and COREX 2.0 technology. The transparent pod design makes it easy to track your e-liquid levels, while the Smart Liq-Cycle system ensures steady coil saturation for consistently excellent flavour. *Puff count is an estimate and depends on the length of draw on each use.
